newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi riyal deposits rise, spot riyal steady.
newsitem.headline: Saudi riyal deposits rise, spot riyal steady.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal against the dollar was unchanged this week but most riyal interbank deposit rates rose 1/16 point in fairly active trade, dealers in Saudi Arabia said on Wednesday.
"The market was fairly active this week. There was enough liquidity," one Riyadh-based dealer said. The spot Saudi riyal was quoted at 3.7504/06 to the dollar, unchanged from last week.
Interbank deposit rates climbed 1/16 point for most periods.
One-month rates were put at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent, three months 5-7/8 3/4 percent, six months at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year maturities were quoted at 6-3/8, 1/4 percent.
